title: Imported Food Import & Sales Business Registration in Korea: Requirements & Procedure | YouSun Administrative Agency
h1: Imported Food Importer / Distributor Business Registration in Korea
lead: To import and sell food in Korea you need a business registration — not just a report — and you submit the registration application with the training certificate and other documents to the Regional Food and Drug Administration after the required facilities are ready. The statutory fee is KRW 28,000. (Law status as of 2026-10-02, per law.go.kr.)
summary: Scope: a business that imports and sells imported food, etc.
Method: business registration — file the application after facilities are in place.
Training: 4 hours of hygiene training before starting.
Facilities: an independent office and hygienic storage (a separate warehouse may be omitted if you do not sell directly to consumers).

sections.h2: What is imported food business registration?
sections.body: An imported-food import and sales business imports and sells imported food, etc. Import businesses are classified as import/sales, report agency, internet purchase agency and storage businesses, and anyone starting such a business must register it.

(1) Facilities: an independent office is required, except where an office for another purpose is shared without hindering business activity. An import/sales business needs a warehouse able to store goods hygienically, which may be set up or leased at a place other than the registered address. A separate warehouse may be omitted if goods are not sold directly to consumers.

(2) Training: take hygiene training beforehand — 4 hours. It may be delivered in a classroom or online. After registration, 3 hours of training are required each year.

(3) Restrictions: registration is not allowed if the facilities do not meet the standards, if you apply for the same type of business at the same place before 6 months have passed since registration was cancelled, or if the applicant is under adult guardianship or is an undischarged bankrupt.

(4) Note: a registered food manufacturer, etc. that imports raw materials for its own products is deemed registered.

The registration application (electronic documents allowed), with (1) the training completion certificate if training was taken beforehand and (2) a facility use contract if the storage facility is leased or a shared facility is used as an independent office. The authority checks the land-use plan confirmation, building register and corporate registry through shared administrative information. If the authority cannot internally confirm disqualification grounds it may request identity documents; a foreign applicant may be asked for a document issued by the government of the home country or another competent authority, or a notarized statement.

(1) Complete pre-start hygiene training → (2) prepare the office and warehouse → (3) submit the application and documents → (4) the authority reviews and issues the business registration certificate. At the import stage, a notification must be filed to import food, overseas manufacturers must be registered before import notification and that registration is valid for 2 years from the registration date.

This review did not confirm a statutory processing period, so no number of days is given. The law requires the authority to review the application and then issue the certificate. Training and facility preparation take additional time; ask the receiving office for its processing period.
The head of the Regional Food and Drug Administration.

The fee for a business registration application is KRW 28,000. The basis is Article 41 of the Imported Food Safety Control Act and Article 50 / Appendix 15 of its Enforcement Rule. Change registration costs KRW 26,500 for a location change and KRW 9,300 for other changes. (Enforcement Rule effective 2026-09-30. Private service fees are not statutory fees and are excluded.)

Reasons confirmed in the law: facility standards not met, same type of business at the same place within 6 months of cancellation, or an applicant under guardianship / undischarged bankrupt. On documents, the training certificate and facility use contract must not be missing where required. Operating without registration can lead to up to 5 years' imprisonment or a fine of up to KRW 50 million, or both.

sections.h2: What can an administrative agent help with?
sections.body: YouSun Administrative Agency prepares and submits application or report documents on your authorization. Work restricted by other laws cannot be handled, and litigation or court representation is outside the scope of an administrative agent and is not offered. Approval, registration or acceptance, and the outcome, are decided by the competent authority.

faq.q: Is it a report or a registration?
faq.a: A registration. Anyone starting this business must register it.

faq.q: Can I register without an office?
faq.a: An independent office is the rule, but sharing an office used for another purpose is allowed where it does not hinder business activity. Confirm your case with the authority.
An import/sales business must have a hygienic warehouse, but a separate one may be omitted if you do not sell directly to consumers.

faq.q: How long is the pre-start training, and can it be online?
faq.a: 4 hours, in a classroom or online.

faq.q: What if I move or take over the business?
faq.a: A location change must be registered within 30 days of the cause, and succession to a business must be reported within 1 month of the succession. The succession report fee is KRW 9,300.

faq.q: I am a food manufacturer — do I need a separate registration to import raw materials?
faq.a: A manufacturer, etc. importing raw materials for its own products is deemed registered; imports for sale must be reviewed separately.

faq.q: Who decides whether an application is approved?
faq.a: The competent authority decides. The administrative agent supports document preparation and submission for applications or reports.

citations.text: Registration: a person starting the business must register the business with the Minister of Food and Drug Safety
citations.source: 수입식품안전관리 특별법 제15조 (law as of 2026-10-02, law.go.kr (Korean original))

citations.text: Facility standard: an independent office for business activity is required
citations.source: 수입식품안전관리 특별법 시행규칙 별표0007의00 (law as of 2026-10-02, law.go.kr (Korean original))
